title: One broke apart - but looks good on curtain.
text:
One broke apart - but looks good on curtain.. They look good at a great price, but made cheaply. Looks like they were put together with hot glue gun. after two months of use, one fell apart and it is hard to glue back together because the hole the hook goes into the knob is filled with dried glue and there is little room to stick the hook back in.

I like the way they look on my shower curtain so I will try and fix anyway I can and keep them.
